summary: Phase 3 UI surface is correctly teacher-gated at the server component, uses sanitized text rendering with no dangerous HTML, routes persistence through the Phase 2 client adapter, and contains no secrets or cross-teacher draft loading. Added a route-level authorization test to provide executable evidence of the gate. Targeted tests, lint, and root tsc pass. App-level tsc shows pre-existing/Phase-3 type errors that are not security-relevant.
nonblocking_findings: Low: apps/integrated-math-3 npx tsc --noEmit reports many pre-existing type errors (problemFamilyId->variantKey schema drift, tailwind.config.ts darkMode typing, etc.) plus a small number of Phase 3-only type errors (relative convex import resolution, ActivityRenderer callback signatures, Composer prop typing). None affect runtime security or route authorization; root npx tsc --noEmit exits 0.

Low: AuthoredLessonPreview renders activities through ActivityRenderer but the current ActivityRenderer public contract does not accept authored props, so preview shows component shells rather than configured content. This is a functional/rendering gap, not a security or authorization issue, and is consistent with the Phase 3 no-op adapter scope.
evidence: Route /teacher/content-authoring/page.tsx is an async server component that calls requireTeacherSessionClaims('/auth/login') before rendering ClientComposer or AuthoredLessonPreview; non-teachers are redirected by the same helper used in /teacher/dashboard, /teacher/lessons, and /teacher/lesson/[lessonSlug].

Added __tests__/app/teacher/content-authoring/page.test.tsx proves the server component invokes requireTeacherSessionClaims('/auth/login') and propagates the auth redirect for unauthenticated/non-teacher callers.

No dangerouslySetInnerHTML, __html, eval(), or raw HTML injection paths found in the new composer/preview/status modules; authored free text flows through SanitizedText -> sanitizeAuthoringText and is emitted as plain text nodes.

ClientComposer and LessonComposer never import Convex handlers directly; persistence actions (save/submit/edit) are injected via the client prop and currently wired to no-op stubs, so Phase 2 handlers remain the only persistence boundary.
composer-state.ts reuses Phase 1 normalizeLessonDraft, validateActivityConfig, and sanitizeLessonDraft; no parallel validator or custom sanitizer is introduced.
get-teacher-authoring-status-view.ts accepts only canonical TeacherFacingStatus values and throws for persisted review/archived strings, preventing client-side status inference.
No API keys, secrets, passwords, tokens, or private keys detected in the Phase 3 changed files.
The route does not load drafts from the server; it uses a hard-coded seed fixture, so there is no cross-teacher draft leakage surface in Phase 3.
measure/tracks.md lists the track as PLANNED and does not claim composer/preview is shipped, so anti-pattern A6 (registry overstatement) is not triggered.
Anti-pattern A2 (consent-blind publish gate) is not applicable: Phase 3 does not implement a publish action; it only surfaces status, and any publish logic remains in Phase 2 handlers.
